candidates.name: Uterine fibroid
support_spans: a hard, adherent, and painless mass
a 6.0 × 7.6 × 6.0 cm solid mass located between the uterus and the rectum
a 7.4 cm nodular solid mass in the same location
candidates.why: The mass is located between the uterus and the rectum and is described as a solid mass, which is consistent with a uterine fibroid.

candidates.name: Ovarian tumor
support_spans: a hard, adherent, and painless mass
a 6.0 × 7.6 × 6.0 cm solid mass located between the uterus and the rectum
contradict_spans: the mass indented the posterior uterine wall without invasion of adjacent organs
candidates.why: The mass is located near the ovary and is described as a solid mass, but the imaging features are more consistent with a uterine fibroid.

candidates.name: Leiomyosarcoma
support_spans: a 7.4 cm nodular solid mass
multiple tortuous enhancing vessels at the periphery
contradict_spans: attenuation values rising from 20 Hounsfield units (HU) pre-contrast to 70 HU on delayed images
candidates.why: The mass has imaging features that could be consistent with a leiomyosarcoma, but the attenuation values are more consistent with a benign process.
